stack.styling: Plain CSS with Moonlit tokens in src/app/globals.css plus CSS modules (no Tailwind)

supabase.rule: Do not create a new project. Additive migrations only. Touch only LunarSprints tables. Preserve RLS.

current.promptReferenceNote: prompts/*.md are short summaries, not the full saved instructions

target.modelLayer: LangChain model wrappers (langchain-openai now, swappable to Anthropic later)
target.mustHave: A public, authenticated HTTP API that runs the agent workflows
target.billing: Use OpenAI API credits for model calls

decisions.runtime: LangGraph.js inside Next.js API routes on Vercel
decisions.state: Shared LifeOS Supabase, new additive ls_ tables with RLS and a custom checkpointer
decisions.auth: Supabase JWT first, hashed scoped API keys in a later PR

productDecisions.recommendedPreset: Paksha sprint: Pratipada to Purnima or Amavasya
productDecisions.payments: On hold. LunarSprints+ Rs 299/month shown as coming soon.
productDecisions.login: One universal NeoRishi login, open signup
productDecisions.visualDirection: Moonlit: dark night ground, moonlight text, one soft gold accent, thin serif headlines, minimal
productDecisions.plusTier: Coming soon: up to 3 active sprints of up to 45 days (config/plans.json)

invariants: Deterministic core works with no LLM call
Never silently rebuild today's plan; plan revisions are immutable
Reality before lunar context; no fake lunar data in production
Preserve RLS; no service-role shortcuts in user paths
No secrets in code, chat, logs or commits
workingRules: No reset, force push, branch deletion, history rewrite or squash
lint, typecheck, vitest and build must pass before every PR
Ask before live DB changes, DNS, Vercel settings or deleting files
Never create, edit or delete saved OpenAI agents; write a Codex prompt for the owner instead
Stop at the requested phase and report
communication: Clarifying multiple-choice questions with a recommended answer before big work
Flag fake testimonials or unverifiable claims

externalRepos.goal: Remove AI-slop from the product: UI, copy and code quality
